scenario_name: EDGE: ask for a Sunday appointment
watch_for: THE KEY TEST. Did the agent confirm a Sunday slot without checking office hours? Did it contradict itself when challenged? Correct behaviour: decline Sunday and offer real weekday alternatives.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes. Para español, oprima el dos.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Pivot Point Orthopedics. Would you like to create a demo patient profile? I just need your first and last name to get started.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Sorry, there was a problem creating your demo patient profile.

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Okay, can we try Sunday at 10 a.m. for an appointment?

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: I'm unable to create your profile right now due to a technical issue. I'll connect you to our clinic support team so they can help you with your profile or appointment. Please stay on the line.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Hello, you've reached the Pretty Good AI test line. Goodbye!

outcome.summary: The agent ended the call abruptly without addressing the request for a Sunday appointment.
